features.name: Pack skills leave the global install and are linked into the repos that list them
features.description: T15 (T10's second half) of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-17-two-layer-harness-design.md, decisions D7 and D10. install.sh installs every skill as before, then `harness_adapter.py store-packs` moves the skills of every pack but core out of each agent's global skills dir into <runtime>/pack-skills/<agent>/. sync links the packs a repo's agent-harness.json lists into its .claude/skills (claude), .agents/skills (agy, codex) and .kiro/skills, from that agent's stored copy or any other agent's; unlinks packs it no longer lists; never replaces a repo's own skill of the same name; and lists the links in a marked block of .git/info/exclude, since they point at this host. infra moved into core: its skills are host tools whose instructions call ~/.claude/skills/infra/... . hangar lists tracking, atelier ai and frontend; spec-gated is company-only. Also fixed: install.sh wrote kiro's agent config before installing skills, so it always listed the previous install's skills (none on a first install).
acceptance_criteria: store-packs moves only pack skills (links as links, dirs as dirs) and can run again after the next install
sync links listed packs for every agent dir, unlinks dropped ones, keeps a repo's own skill and keeps links out of git
live: a pack skill loads in its repo and not elsewhere, for claude and agy; a spec-gated skill is no longer global
kiro's agent config lists the installed skills, none of the moved ones
all 11 harness gates pass, with gate output saved to a file
features.verification: python3 -m pytest tests/test_harness_adapter.py -q && bash scripts/tests/test_install_source_guard.sh && bash scripts/harness-verify.sh
features.evidence: Tests first: 3 new adapter tests failed (no store-packs or linking), 39 passed after; test_install_source_guard.sh kiro case failed on the old install order and passes after. Two tests used pack skills as samples (infra as a valid pack, apidog as an installed local skill); now tracking and spec-workflow. Live probe before building: a skill in <repo>/.claude/skills and .agents/skills loads for claude (-p, haiku) and agy when the session starts in the repo, and not from its parent folder. After install.sh --agent all and sync-all: 17 pack skills moved out of ~/.claude/skills, ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills, ~/.codex/skills and ~/.kiro/skills (global entries 35 -> 18); hangar links kanban-ai and linear, atelier ai-stack and webapp-testing, for all three agent dirs, git status clean. Live: claude in hangar sees linear (YES), from ~/projects not (NO), jira from ~/projects NO; agy in atelier sees ai-stack (YES), in hangar NO. kiro default.json: 18 resources, no moved skill. repo_audit 2026-10-18: hangar skills 34 -> 19, skill-description tokens 2380 -> 1158, always-loaded 5389 -> 4167; atelier 34 -> 19, 2380 -> 1151, 5014 -> 3785. Known limits: a session started outside a repo (e.g. ~/projects) gets no pack skills; uninstall.sh leaves <runtime>/pack-skills and the repo links in place; codex not live-tested.

features.name: Pack skills in the repos' shared parent; uninstall removes pack links
features.description: Follow-ups to feat-090. A session started in the folder above the repos (~/projects) loaded no pack skills, since agents read skills from the folder the session starts in. sync-all now links the union of the registered repos' packs into their shared parent, unless that folder is at or above HOME, the filesystem root, or inside a git repo. uninstall.sh runs `harness_adapter.py unlink-packs --agent A` per agent: it removes that agent's stored pack skills and every repo or parent link into them, and rewrites each repo's .git/info/exclude block to the links that remain.
acceptance_criteria: sync-all links every listed pack into the shared parent and drops packs no repo lists any more
nothing is linked when the shared parent is HOME or inside a git repo
unlink-packs removes one agent's store and only the links into it, and updates the exclude block
live: claude and agy started in ~/projects see a pack skill
all 11 harness gates pass, with gate output saved to a file

features.name: Weekly harness evaluation of every target repo, silent unless worse
features.description: Nothing ran update.sh or the repo audits on a schedule, so a newly installed agent, a drifted hook or a failing verify surfaced only by hand. scripts/harness_weekly.py takes update.sh's output and exit code, audits each registered repo into <runtime>/audits/<repo>/<date>.json (per machine: committing here would break update.sh's pull --ff-only once the remote moves), compares with the latest earlier audit and writes a markdown report with the repo_trend table. Regressions: update.sh failed; a repo failed to sync; a new outside agent detected (codex once installed) or a listed one not answering; a hook drifted; always-loaded tokens up more than 10%; a repo's latest verify run failed. Exit 1 on regressions, 2 on no verdict. hangar's scripts/jobs/harness-weekly.sh (LaunchAgent top.firstdigital.harness-weekly, Monday 09:30) runs update.sh then this, writes ~/hangar-weekly/harness-<YYYY-Www>.md and sends ntfy only on regressions or no verdict.
acceptance_criteria: each regression class is reported, and a clean week reports none
the latest verify run decides, not an earlier failure
this week's audit is saved per machine and compared with the latest earlier one
exit 1 only on regressions, with the report written either way
the hangar job runs end to end on this host and is silent on a clean week
features.evidence: tests/test_harness_weekly.py written first (module missing), 5 passed after. Dry run on the real runtime: no regressions, table for atelier and hangar, audits saved to ~/.agent-skills-setup/audits/. hangar job run once by hand: update.sh exit 0, no regressions, report ~/hangar-weekly/harness-2026-W42.md, job metrics written, no ntfy sent. LaunchAgent bootstrapped (Weekday 1, 09:30). hangar's CronJobNotRunning rule now covers harness-weekly at the weekly threshold. Not exercised: the ntfy path (no regression this week). Follow-up the same day: the weekly report adds 'Outside reviews of risky commits' per repo (registered repos and the harness): commits touching hooks, gates, install scripts, agent settings, CI, the shipped rules or migrations, Renovate excluded, and how many an outside-agent review in that repo followed within 2 days (outside-agent-runs.jsonl; subagent reviews leave no record). Measured, not a regression. Tests failed first (2), 7 pass; runs on system Python 3.9. First real numbers, 7 days to 2026-10-18: hangar 13 risky / 0 reviewed, atelier 13 / 0, agent-skills-setup 21 / 0. ntfy path exercised with a stand-in update.sh that exits 1: HTTP 200; the real job rerun after, clean. hangar-sync run by hand on top2 (owner asked): prometheus applied, the CronJobNotRunning rule with harness-weekly is loaded.

features.name: Telemetry gaps: whole gate names, failing tests, session ids, tool errors and denials, weekly rework, no duplicate trace rows
features.description: From the 2026-10-19 log review (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-19-telemetry-gaps-design.md, T1-T10). Gate-run rows keep a failed gate's full name (runtime drift was split in two), list the failing test files, and carry CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID; verify-gate rows carry the hook input's session_id; outside-agent attempt rows carry repo and session. Run records count failed tool calls (is_error) and permission denials (toolDenialKind), keep only test file names, and leave out rows that name another session. harness_weekly.py adds a Rework section (a fix changing code another commit changed in the 48 h before). A second trace snapshot of one commit and agent replaces the first. State layer back under 6,000 tokens (feat-061..086 to progress-archive.md, feat-085..088 to docs/archive/features). The review rule adds a per-group review for long hook/gate/install branches; hangar AGENTS.md gets a Tier 3 section; Claude Code keeps transcripts 90 days.
acceptance_criteria: each change has a test that failed first
a real gate run row names runtime drift whole and the session
a real run record of this session shows tool errors and denials
the rework section runs on all three repos
the state layer is under its token limit
all 11 harness gates pass after deploy (runtime drift needs install.sh)
